product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic provides an enterprise integration and applied-AI platform for organizations to connect applications, data, APIs, and AI agents and build and operate integrated workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an agentic integration platform unifying apps, data, and agents.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page exists; pricing information is offered even if the visitor must contact sales for a quote.

named_customers.notes: These names appear on the customer page and Boston University case study.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company page gives the headquarters address in San Mateo, California.

founded_year.notes: SnapLogic press release states it was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The technical blog category includes multiple engineering implementation posts, including posts by engineers on token propagation and developer production clones.

public_docs.notes: SnapLogic publishes extensive product documentation, including Snap reference material, API documentation, and AI/LLM integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job listing's current roles include engineering positions but no role title matching the specified AI/ML/data-science categories.

model_provider.value: The product documentation supports several providers rather than identifying one exclusive provider: Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google GenAI, and OpenAI.
model_provider.notes: Public documentation describes LLM Snaps for each of these providers; this does not imply the company uses a single exclusive provider internally.

compliance_certs.notes: The page specifically states SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-HITECH. It also lists SOC 1/SOC 3, but those are not among the requested certification labels.

last_funding.notes: SnapLogic announced $165 million on December 13, 2021; funding trackers identify this as its Series G round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest verified publicly announced round located is from December 2021, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current Senior Enterprise Account Executive role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: SnapLogic's October 2026 product release, dated October 22, 2026 in the indexed release listing, is inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: SnapLogic announced Molly Matthews's appointment as President and executive leadership promotions in May 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both named systems appear in SnapLogic's connector pages. No conclusion is made that either is its internal CRM.
